title: MemoryEvidence
description: Tamper-evident memory read/write record — binds an agent memory access to a content digest and the digest of the memory state observed immediately before, so a chain of memory operations is verifiable and non-repudiable. Shares the AEP signature envelope.

schema_version.description: Semver-like schema identifier for the memory-evidence evidence type

trace_id.description: Optional correlation ID linking related evidence records

mem_ref.description: Stable reference (URI or opaque id) of the memory cell or region accessed

digest.description: Content digest of the memory value read or written (e.g. sha256:...)

prior_digest.description: Content digest of the memory cell immediately before this op; null on a cold read / first write so the chain start is explicit

timestamp_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the memory op was recorded

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the record content
